list.title: CssSelector
list.description: CSS Selector String

list.title: Editor#createDraft
list.description:
Encrypt and sign the content of the editor with the default key of the user.
To be used to save drafts. To restore drafts use the options.armoredDraft parameter of the createEditorContainer method.

list.title: Editor#encrypt
list.description: Requests the encryption of the editor content for the given recipients.

list.title: Generator#generate
list.description: Generate a private key

list.title: Keyring#addSyncHandler
list.description: Add various functions for keyring synchronization

list.title: Keyring#additionalHeadersForOutgoingEmail
list.description:
Returns headers that should be added to an outgoing email.
So far this is only the autocrypt header.

list.title: Keyring#createKeyBackupContainer
list.description: Creates an iframe to initiate the key backup process.

list.title: Keyring#createKeyGenContainer
list.description:
Creates an iframe to display the key generation container.
The iframe will be injected into the container identified by selector.

list.title: Keyring#exportOwnPublicKey
list.description:
Exports the public key as an ascii armored string.
Only keys belonging to the user (corresponding private key exists) can be exported.

list.title: Keyring#hasPrivateKey
list.description: Check if keyring contains valid private key with given fingerprint

list.title: Keyring#importPublicKey
list.description: Asks the user if they want to import the public key.

list.title: Keyring#openSettings
list.description: Open the extension settings in a new browser tab

list.title: Keyring#processAutocryptHeader
list.description: Process Autocrypt header from message being read.

list.title: Keyring#restoreBackupContainer
list.description: Creates an iframe to restore the backup.

list.title: Keyring#setLogo
list.description:
Set logo for keyring. The image is persisted in Mailvelope with a revision number,
therefore the method is only required after new keyring generation or if logo and revision number changes.

list.title: Keyring#validKeyForAddress
list.description:
Checks for valid key in the keyring for provided email addresses
If none is found also checks in other sources (see LookupResult).

list.title: Mailvelope#createDisplayContainer
list.description:
Creates an iframe to display the decrypted content of the encrypted mail.
The iframe will be injected into the container identified by selector.

list.title: Mailvelope#createEditorContainer
list.description:
Creates an iframe with an editor for a new encrypted mail.
The iframe will be injected into the container identified by selector.

list.title: Mailvelope#createEncryptedFormContainer
list.description:
Creates an iframe to display an encrypted form
The iframe will be injected into the container identified by selector.

list.title: Mailvelope#createKeyring
list.description: Creates a Keyring for the given identifier

list.title: Mailvelope#createSettingsContainer
list.description:
Creates an iframe to display the keyring settings.
The iframe will be injected into the container identified by selector.

list.title: Mailvelope#getKeyring
list.description: Retrieves the Keyring for the given identifier

list.title: Mailvelope#getVersion
list.description: Gives access to the mailvelope extension version

list.title: module:web-components
list.description:
Custom HTML elements that wrap the client-API for declarative use in markup.
Each element is registered as an HTML custom element when the client-API
script loads, so they can be authored directly as HTML tags — no JavaScript
needed beyond optional event listeners.
